channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Chewing gum reduces HPV levels by up to 93%
item.description: An experimental gum cut HPV by up to 93% and nearly eliminated two bacteria linked to head and neck cancer, with treatment preserving healthy cells.

item.title: Shroud of Turin DNA reveals centuries of hidden history
item.description: DNA analysis of the Shroud of Turin shows a diverse mix of human, microbial, plant, animal, and coral traces accumulated over centuries of handling and travel.

item.title: Fossil of 518-million-year-old creature sheds light on spider fang origins
item.description: A small marine fossil from 518 million years ago provides the earliest evidence of structures that later evolved into spider fangs.

item.title: New NSF hubs to expand AI infrastructure for scientific research nationwide
item.description: The initiative aims to boost AI-enabled science by providing researchers and students with greater access to computing resources through regional hubs.
